# SYNTHETIC JOB DESCRIPTION 05 — Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineer
# Label: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE (NOT A REAL JOB POSTING)

Role: Graduate Engineer Trainee — Embedded Systems (GET)
Company: VoltMobility Smart EV Solutions
Location: Coimbatore / Chennai, India
Salary: ₹5.0 LPA - ₹7.5 LPA

Role Overview:
VoltMobility manufactures smart telematics and battery management electronics for commercial electric vehicles in India. We are recruiting fresh electronics graduates eager to write bare-metal and RTOS firmware for automotive IoT controllers.

Core Duties:
• Develop embedded software for ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers (STM32 / NXP) in Embedded C.
• Write low-level device drivers for communication peripherals (CAN bus, SPI, I2C, UART).
• Debug hardware-firmware integration issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD probes.
• Integrate FreeRTOS scheduling tasks, semaphores, and inter-task message queues.

Must Have Requirements:
• B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics & Communication (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EEE), or Embedded Systems.
• Fluent in Embedded C and basic C++ programming.
• Understanding of microcontroller hardware architecture (interrupts, timers, ADC, GPIOs).
• Knowledge of serial protocols: UART, SPI, I2C.
• Practical laboratory experience with breadboarding, oscilloscopes, and multimeter testing.

Nice to Have:
• Familiarity with FreeRTOS or similar real-time operating systems.
• Understanding of CAN protocol (CAN 2.0B / CAN FD).
• Basic Python scripting for automated hardware test jigs.
